The recorded reference

CMU Graphics Lab, subject 07, trial 04: slow walk. The skeleton below follows a short extracted cycle, with drift removed and the loop smoothed. The painted adaptation preserves planted-foot constraints and our body proportions; it is not an exact motion-capture replay.

CMU recording catalog · Walk-cycle teaching reference

Scope and sources

Body rise and fall, restrained balance/lean, swing-foot timing and arm timing come from the recording. Knees use the shared foot targets with a continuous leg solve instead of a held landing silhouette. Torso depth rotation is approximated with small projected shoulder offsets and lean; the painted torso remains a 2D piece. No new character art or background was generated. Shop actions and the cast preview retain their existing motion.

The data used in this project was obtained from mocap.cs.cmu.edu. The database was created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217. BVH conversion obtained through the cmubvh mirror. Pose labels are approximate review landmarks. Passing the mechanical checks does not establish naturalness.
